request_patterns.description: Real-time transaction scoring -- inbound transaction event, returns allow/deny/escalate within SLA
request_patterns.typical_resolution: Automated verdict based on composite risk score; 89% ALLOW, 6% DENY, 5% ESCALATE

request_patterns.description: Batch retroactive review -- compliance team submits batch of past transactions for re-evaluation against updated rules
request_patterns.typical_resolution: Re-score each transaction against current policy; flag discrepancies for human review

request_patterns.description: Member dispute investigation -- triggered when a member challenges a denied or flagged transaction
request_patterns.typical_resolution: Pull full transaction context, compare against member history, produce investigation summary for analyst

ambiguity_resolutions.scenario: Transaction amount is exactly at the configured threshold boundary (e.g. $10,000.00)
ambiguity_resolutions.learned_resolution: Treat boundary-exact amounts as above-threshold; the cost of a false negative exceeds the cost of a false positive at boundary values

ambiguity_resolutions.scenario: Merchant is in a high-risk MCC category but the member has a long history of transactions with this specific merchant
ambiguity_resolutions.learned_resolution: Weight member-merchant history above MCC risk category when the member has 5+ prior transactions with the same merchant in 90 days

ambiguity_resolutions.scenario: Conflicting signals: geo-location mismatch but device fingerprint matches known member device
ambiguity_resolutions.learned_resolution: Favor device fingerprint match; VPN and mobile roaming cause frequent geo-mismatches. Escalate only if both geo AND device are anomalous.

learned_quirks: Occasionally sends duplicate events with identical seq_id within 50ms; dedup by seq_id before scoring
Currency field uses ISO 4217 but sometimes sends lowercase; normalize to uppercase before lookup
Latency spikes to 800ms+ during batch settlement windows (02:00-03:00 UTC); cache member profiles during this window
Returns 404 for recently migrated accounts until T+24h; fall back to legacy endpoint for 404 responses
